content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the compound is the sample at hand, which is implicit. We can get carbon NMR spectra which will list chemical shifts; aromatic carbons appear around 120-150 ppm. Could count peaks. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
